description: This source file implements Parodus communication interface, including connection management, message sending, and notification handling for a device management system. It manages Parodus initialization, message reception, and sending notifications with retries and backoff strategies.

methods.name: connectParodus
methods.description: Establishes and maintains connection to Parodus with exponential backoff retries.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Constructs and sends a notification message to Parodus with retry and backoff logic.

methods.name: getParodusUrl
methods.description: Reads the Parodus URL from device properties file.

methods.name: waitForEthAgentComponentReady
methods.description: Waits until the Ethernet agent component reports healthy status.

methods.name: checkComponentHealthStatus
methods.description: Checks the health status of a specified component via D-Bus.

methods.name: checkEthernetWanStatus
methods.description: Determines if Ethernet WAN is enabled via syscfg or component status.

methods.name: getDeviceMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device MAC address, either from sysevent or via D-Bus, with retries.

methods.name: macToLower
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to lowercase and removes colons.

methods.name: freeNotifyWrpMsg
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a WRP message.

methods.name: freeNotifyParams
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for notification parameters.
